description: field/hit `cat`: the plain word every class, group, alternation and modifier body is built on
field/edge `CAT`: `(?i)cat`'s hit; `(?i)c(?^)at`'s and `(?i)c(?-i)at`'s designed MISS (the reset re-cases `at`)
field/edge `Cat`: the option-reset shapes' hit -- caseless `c`, exact `at`
field/edge `concatenate`: `\Bcat\B`'s hit and `\bcat\b`'s designed miss (the word is inside a longer one)
field/edge `abc`: `(?>a|ab)c` FAILS on it (the atomic group commits to `a`), `(?:ab)+` takes its first two bytes
field/hit `ac`: `(?>a|ab)c`'s whole-string hit -- the atomic alternation's first branch, then `c`
field/hit `abba`: `(\w)(\w)\2\1`'s whole-string hit
field/edge `aaab`: `a+b`, `a+ab`, `(?>a+)b`, `a*+b`, `a{1,2}+b`, `a+(*SKIP)b` hit it; `a++ab` cannot (the possessive plus keeps the last `a`)
field/hit `item`: `item(?! done)`'s and `item(*ACCEPT)done`'s whole-string hit
field/hit `done`: `done$`, `done\Z`, `done\z` and `(?m)done$` whole-string hit (the lookbehind shapes cannot hit whole: nothing precedes offset 0)
field/hit `item done`: the lookaround, `(?s)`, `\040` and `$`/`\Z`/`\z` bodies' hit with NO trailing newline
field/edge `item done\n`: `done$` and `done\Z` match before the final newline, `done\z` does not
field/edge `item\ndone`: `item\ndone`, `\R`, `\v+`, `(?s)item.done` hit; `(?m)^` and `(?m)$` fire at the internal newline; `it\Nm`'s companion
field/edge `item\r\ndone`: `\R` matches the pair as one newline, `\v+` as two bytes, `item\ndone` not at all
field/hit `42`: `\d+`'s whole-string hit
field/hit `2026-09-05`: the subroutine-call shapes (`(\d{2})\g<1>`, `(?+1)(\d{2})`, `(\d{2})(?-1)`, `(?P>d)`) hit its first four digits under search and none of it whole
field/hit `12:34`: the `(?(DEFINE)...)` shape's whole-string hit
field/hit `2026`: the four subroutine-call spellings' whole-string hit (two digits, then the group called again)
field/hit `foo_bar9`: `\w+` whole, `[[:alpha:]]+` and `\p{L}+` only a prefix
field/hit `key=value`: `key\h*=\h*value` and `key=\K\w+` (reported span 4-9)
field/hit `key\tvalue`: the `\t` escape's whole-string hit
field/hit `the the`: the numbered, relative, python-style and `(?J)` backreference shapes' whole-string hit
field/hit `bold`: the named backreference's whole-string hit
field/hit `(a(b)c)`: the four recursion shapes' whole-string hit at nesting depth 2
field/edge `(a(bc)`: unbalanced -- the recursion shapes take `(bc)` under search and nothing whole
field/hit `"hello"`: `".*?"` and `(?U)".+"` whole-string hit
field/hit `f(x)`: `\Qf(x)\E`'s whole-string hit
field/hit `#42`: the floor's ONLY hit among the fields
field/edge `caf\xe9`: `\p{L}+` and `caf\x{e9}` take it whole; `\w+` and `[[:alpha:]]+` stop at the Latin-1 byte
field/hit `bell\x07end`: `bell\cGend`'s whole-string hit
